NAME: The token expired while the tab was frozen: the websocket reconnects with a renewed token, no popup
SUITE: Authorization: websocket after the token expired or the session ended

DESCRIPTION: The other tab has logged out, so there is no signed-in user when the websocket reconnects: no handshake, the popup names the websocket request. The client asks for a token again after a doubling delay and never sends a handshake without a token, so it comes back by itself once a token is available again.

SUITE: Authorization: websocket after the token expired or the session ended
